title: Judge orders transfer of Thomas Markle to face formal charges in California
summary:
Father of the Duchess of Sussex currently being held in Florida is charged with possession of child pornography

blocks.text: A judge in the US has ordered the transfer of Thomas Markle, the Duchess of Sussex’s father, to California to face formal charges of possessing child sex abuse images.

The move comes after a federal grand jury on the west coast paved the way for the prosecution of Markle Sr, who is currently being held in custody in Florida. He was charged with two counts of possession of child pornography.
The transportation of Markle Sr to the charging jurisdiction was ordered by the magistrate judge Lindsay Griffin in Florida on Wednesday, according to documents seen by the Press Association.
The 82-year-old is expected to appear before a Los Angeles judge in the coming weeks, where he will hear the charges against him and is likely to be asked to enter a plea.
The grand jury filing alleges that on or about 30 October and 4 November of this year, Markle Sr “knowingly possessed 35mm film negatives that contained child pornography”.

The negatives are alleged to include images that “involved a prepubescent minor and a minor who had not yet attained the age of 12 years old”. If convicted, he faces up to 20 years in prison on each count.
Markle Sr was detained by FBI agents on 6 November after they seized a cache of material from two Los Angeles storage units that he rented for nearly two decades.

He came under investigation after he was reported to police in the Philippines and the FBI last month by his son, Thomas Markle Jr, who allegedly found illegal images in his father’s belongings in Cebu City.
Markle Jr told the Sun newspaper he had tipped off the authorities about the LA storage facilities.
The US attorney’s office for the central district of California stated: “Every defendant is presumed to be innocent until and unless proven guilty in court.”
After initially being released on conditional bail following his arrest in Florida, Markle Sr was detained just days later after removing his electronic monitoring tag.
During his interview for this, Markle Sr claimed not to understand the allegations against him and that he did not have “any child porn” and “no pictures of naked kids”.
Meghan, who moved back to the UK with the Duke of Sussex in August, has said previously she was “deeply distressed” at the accusations against her father, from whom she is estranged.

She revealed she was sent a letter via the Metropolitan Police and Royalty and Specialist Protection in 2019 which made “troubling and disturbing allegations” about her father, but she was given assurances these were being investigated.
The Met has admitted it never shared the details with other law enforcement agencies, with the police watchdog, the Independent Office for Police Conduct, now investigating the force’s conduct.
